claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true
claims.evidence: No new photos, videos, or test readings were provided to verify the claim.

risks.risk: Panel rating/specs (wattage, voltage, efficiency) are unknown; price depends on these.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the panel nameplate showing watt rating (W), Vmp/Voc, Imp/Isc, and model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-spec used/uncertain panel (worst case: lower wattage and no warranty).

risks.risk: Item mismatch risk: seller’s claims are about batteries, but photos show only solar panels.
risks.proof: Confirm what exactly is being sold (panel vs battery vs inverter) and send photos of the exact item(s) matching the claims.
risks.if_unproven: Price only for the solar panel shown; do not price as a battery/inverter.

risks.risk: Condition/damage risk (microcracks, water ingress) cannot be confirmed from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-ups of all four corners/edges and junction box; plus backsheet photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/untested (worst case: reduced performance).

risks.risk: No warranty/brand verification; counterfeit/non-original panels possible without labels.
risks.proof: Photo of brand/logo and full specifications label; any warranty/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unverified brand with no warranty.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the panel’s label/nameplate (watt rating and model/serial).
Send photos of the exact battery/inverter being claimed (if included), including label and any test readings.
Provide the test evidence for the “8 hours” claim (video or screenshot of battery voltage before/after and the load used, with time).
response.reason: The seller asserts testing, but without new photos/videos or readable specs, the key details needed to price correctly (panel rating and/or the actual battery being sold) remain unverified.
